units.source_text: 流放须磨，主要原因是胧月夜之事。

en.t: The main reason for his exile to Suma was the affair with Oborozukiyo.

units.source_text: “空流”乃故意掩饰之词，故下文又言“有名无实”。

en.t: The phrase "empty exile" was deliberately used to conceal the truth, which is why the text later calls it "a name without substance."
